decisions.reason: The electrometer is close to the firm's established dosimetry and QA instruments, builds on its related R&D knowledge, and is a flagship focus, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it.
Risk management software for oncology builds on the firm's established software and oncology QA knowledge, enabling the firm to interpret results and improve it.
The CT image quality phantom extends the firm's existing medical imaging QA and benefits from its R&D capabilities, supporting absorbable learning and retention.
This mammography phantom is distant from the firm's established offer and related knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret early results and learn.
The full field mammography phantom is also distant from the firm's established expertise, weakening absorptive capacity and making a drop likely.
Medical imaging QA instruments build directly on the firm's existing QA and software integration strengths and are a flagship line, so the firm can assimilate feedback and keep them.
